# Loyal Fitness

> Loyal Fitness is a neighbourhood strength and fitness gym in Kushalnagar, Kodagu (Coorg), Karnataka, India. It offers free weights, strength machines, treadmills and trainer guidance for strength, muscle gain, fat loss and complete beginners.

## Key facts

- Name: Loyal Fitness (Kannada: ಲಾಯಲ್ ಫಿಟ್ನೆಸ್)
- Type: Gym / exercise gym
- Address: 3rd floor, Abhi Gowda Complex, Old Market Road, opposite Kodava cemetery, Kushalnagar, Karnataka 571234, India
- Landmarks: Near the Ganapathi Temple and the Kushalnagar bus stand; red Loyal Fitness signboard
- Coordinates: 12.4574615, 75.9602749
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 98865 43872, +91 83100 22678
- Head trainer: Brijesh Kumar
- Members: about 50
- Open since: 2026 (about six months)
- Timings and membership fees: shared on request by phone or WhatsApp; open in the morning and evening
- Visitors can see the gym before paying anything

## Programs

- Strength: barbell and dumbbell work to build raw strength, step by step
- Muscle gain: structured weekly splits for size and shape
- Fat loss: weights plus conditioning to lose fat and keep strength
- Beginners: learn the gym basics with guidance on form

## Equipment

- Free weights (rubber dumbbells from 2.5 kg upward, barbells, plates)
- Strength machines and benches
- Treadmills
